tasks.rationale: State the concrete gap. Example: destination pages carry Organization + Breadcrumb schema but no TouristTrip entity linking the destination to bookable Silk Road itineraries, so AI engines can't surface it for multi-country Central Asia queries.

payload.angle: Extractable statements a generative engine can quote — what it is, who it's for, which real itineraries cover it.
must_cover: Name the real bookable itineraries that visit this destination (from the live /tour/ list — do NOT invent a trip name)
European-operator framing, independent of any Iran/Middle-East corporate identity
One factual logistics line per itinerary (nights, entry points) — never an invented rate or date
